paragraphs.text:
To  avoid  a  riverside  marsh,  you  weave  through  a  forest  of 
mature larch. The uneven terrain makes you wish that Charlie 
was still with your party.
Attempt a Track roll: if you succeed, go to 558; if you fail, go to 569.
